openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Saturday’s gate is clear — not the inbox. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Competitive calm. Fierce. Unbeatable. Own the weekend threshold from the first breath.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for Monday to run the system. Fierce calm is weekend composure under clear sky: charge first, body second, two clean must-dos, quiet admin only after the morning has already won. Competitive. Unbeatable. One breath, one move, one clear next step. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Saturday: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Clear sky outside; tempo inside. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Saturday is the open field, not the empty day
items.body: Old operator manuals treat the weekend as a practice ground — fewer forced meetings, more room to choose the one move that actually changes the shape of next week. Gnostic calendars call this the field of free will: the veil lifts when obligation thins. Use the clear sky. Do not fill it with noise.

Hermetic work separates wandering from seeking. Wandering is open-loop scroll; seeking is timed, aimed, closed. Set a gate on every rabbit hole — twelve minutes, one find, then seal. The mystics weren’t anti-wonder. They were anti-leak.

items.hed: The inner lamp prefers dry weather
items.body: Clear mornings sharpen the practice of seeing what you already carry. When the outer lamp is bright, the inner one doesn’t need to shout — it only needs honesty. Name one truth about the week before you open the feed.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.hed: Guard the gate of the day, even when the court is empty
grimoire.body: Solomon’s courts still opened on quiet days — not for spectacle, but so the king did not lose the habit of order. A weekend without a ring becomes a week without a throne. Your Saturday morning is that court: breath draws the ring, body stands inside it, then one chosen must-do may enter. Empty calendar is not empty rule.
grimoire.practice: After four rounds of box breathing, name one weekend must-do out loud. Then start the 3-minute opener. Do not open mail until both are done.

image.alt: Newsprint diagram — Explore not Doomscroll: Random, Classic, Curated, Human discovery lanes

lesson.oneLiner: Curiosity without a gate becomes an open loop — pick one lane, one find, then close.
beats: Random — Cloudhiker serves surprise sites so you don’t start from the same feed.
Classic — Wiby searches the old lightweight web (subject-first, not engagement-first).
Curated — Web Radar / HumanFound surface human-picked gems algorithms miss.
Gate — set a 12-minute timer; capture one useful find; close the tab.
Rule: explore on purpose. Don’t let a “quick look” steal the morning you just charged.
lesson.takeaway: Weekend operator leverage is protected attention. @mmmik000: one lane → one find → seal. Then get back to the board.
